general_dims.name: polarity
general_dims.definition: Is the main statement or request negated (not/never/no/don't)? 'mixed/unclear' if both or you cannot tell.

general_dims.name: speech_act
general_dims.definition: What the sentence does: tells (statement), asks for information (question), asks someone to do something (request/command), declines (refusal), proposes or offers (offer/suggestion).

general_dims.name: agent
general_dims.definition: Who does the main action: the speaker (I), the listener (you), both (we/let's), someone else (third party), or no doer is stated (unspecified).

general_dims.name: certainty
general_dims.definition: How sure the sentence sounds: plain, hedged (maybe/I think/probably), strongly certain (definitely/really/for sure). Questions and requests: n/a.

general_dims.name: politeness
general_dims.definition: Explicit politeness words only: 'please'; a softened request (could you / would you mind / if possible); thanks or apology. Else none.

added_content.definition: Does the sentence state a fact, reason, person, place or time that is NOT in the input words? Grammar words and chips' meanings do not count.
